    Orbits of pairs of half-words #

    A pair (v, s, h, h') of half-words shifts across the first letter l of h to (l.tgt, !ε l, h₁, l⁻¹ h') (Signs.Step), and swaps to (v, !s, h', h). The pairs at the positions of a string or a band form exactly one orbit of the generated equivalence (Word.orbit_iff, CWord.orbit_iff).

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.HWord.cons_inj {Q : Statement.FinQuiver} {l l' : Letter Q} {h h' : HWord Q} (e : cons l h = cons l' h') :
    l = l' ∧ h = h'
